Farm Africa: 2023-2026: Nature-Based Solutions for Sustainable Development

description.narrative: The overall objective of the programme is to contribute to environmental sustainability, climate resilience and inclusive development in Ethiopia. The goal will be achieved through five mutually reinforcing outcomes as follows: Outcome 1: Improved natural resources, biodiversity and ecosystem services. Outcome 2: Improved sustainable food and nutrition security. Outcome 3: Enhanced inclusive livelihood development. Outcome 4: Increased climate adaptation and mitigation. Outcome 5: Reduced resource-based conflicts through gender-sensitive inter-community peace and conflict resolution.

Det föreslagna programmets övergripande mål att bidra till miljömässig hållbarhet, klimatmotståndskraft och inkluderande utveckling genom att leverera följande övergripande resultat: 1. Förbättrade naturresurser, biologisk mångfald och ekosystemtjänster. 2. Förbättrad hållbar livsmedels­ och näringstrygghet. 3. Förbättrad utveckling av inkluderande försörjningsmöjligheter. 4. Ökad klimatanpassning och utsläppsbegränsning. 5. Minskade konflikter om naturresurser genom jämställdhetsintegrerad freds- och konfliktlösning mellan olika befolkningsgrupper

To contribute to environmental sustainability, climate resilience and inclusive development in Ethiopia. The programme will aim to achieve the following five interlinked results; 1: Improved natural resources, biodiversity and ecosystem services. 2: Improved sustainable food and nutrition security. 3: Enhanced inclusive livelihood development. 4: Increased climate adaptation and mitigation. 5: Reduced resource­based conflicts through gender­sensitive inter­community peace and conflict resolution.

Outcome 1: Improved natural resources, biodiversity, and ecosystem services - Mapping of 24 watersheds, developing sustainable management plans - Strengthened 23 Participatory Forest Management Cooperatives (PFMCs) and established six new PFMCs, along with two Participatory Rangeland Management cooperatives (PRMCs) - Nine youth groups engaged in nursery production. - Supported sustainable park management, benefit sharing mechanisms, and ecotourism initiatives, benefiting 35 women and establishing three women groups with revolving funds. - The nomination document and management plan for the Anywa Biosphere Reserve were finalized, and policy advocacy activities were conducted.
Outcome 2: Improved sustainable food and nutrition security - 60 government experts and 562 community members trained in nutrition-sensitive agriculture and sustainable crop production intensification. - 124 households trained on vermi-composting and provided with necessary inputs to start the business - Postharvest management training was given to 427 individuals - 73 participants trained on urban agriculture - Awareness events on food safety, quality and diversified nutritious food preparation for 733 participants (399 females).
Outcome 3: Enhanced inclusive livelihood development - Establishment of a bamboo enterprise comprising 22 members (10 females), training sessions on bamboo production and marketing
- Training of 151 farmers (44 females) on market-oriented farming, and distribution of improved seeds to 312 farmers (95 females) - Two licensed youth enterprises for fish collection and processing formed - 60 Village Saving and Loan Associations (VSLAs) formed with a total of 1,475 members (1,261 female) they mobilized a total savings amount of 574,771 ETB - Loans totaling 253,880 ETB have been disbursed to 460 VSLA members to support small businesses.
Outcome 4: Increased climate adaptation and mitigation - Training in climate-smart agriculture and vermi composting provided to 454 beneficiaries, and four vermi compost multiplication centers were established - Irrigation farming and water management initiatives were supported, benefiting 572 farmers - Training on green energy technologies and the distribution of cooking stoves and solar lighting conducted
Outcome 5: Reduced resource-based conflicts through gender sensitive inter-community peace and conflict resolution - Assessment to identify root causes of resource conflicts, workable conflict resolution mechanisms - Dialogue sessions on gender equality, training on transformative practices.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
